name: Kevil Patel
title: Associate Software Development Engineer
headline: Building agentic AI on cloud at Kyndryl
taglines: I build agentic AI on cloud.
I design agents that understand language.

about.text: Associate Software Development Engineer at Kyndryl, in the Agentic AI practice, engineering agentic AI systems on Azure AI Foundry for enterprise clients. B.Tech in Computer Science from VIT Vellore (CGPA 8.95, AIR 56 in VITEEE).

Works at the intersection of machine learning, cloud architecture and developer experience: from LSTM grids predicting power loads across 500+ households, to a multi-tenant agentic observability platform (A360), to a LangGraph governance agent that turns plain-English policies into enforced cloud pipelines.
Certified across AWS, Microsoft Azure, GitHub and Founderz.

quote.text: The best engineers do not just write code — they listen to the system breathe.

availability.text: Open to: agentic AI · cloud architecture · platform engineering · collaborations.
